notes.title: 20250918 Path Note
notes.content:
Fixed the wrong ending options in chapter 7 in chapter scene.
Fixed some story line can't be ended properly in chapter 7.
Fixed the issue that some option texts are incorrectly rendered in chapter 8.

notes.title: 20250917更新日志
notes.content: [p]Fixed the issue of missing videos in some languages.[/p][p]Fixed the issue of missing translations for the "Straw Sandals" gameplay in other languages.[/p][p]Fixed the issue where the BGM did not disappear when the interactive subtitle screen vanished.[/p][p]Added a new data repair mechanism.[/p][p]Fixed the issue where the chapter progress bar could exceed 100%.[/p][p]Fixed the issue where the BGM did not stop when jumping to other chapters in the chapter menu.[/p][p]Corrected some typos in subtitles; added an initial entry function for each chapter in the chapter menu (requires unlocking the chapter).[/p][p]Extensive fixes to the connection logic in the chapter menu.[/p][p]Fixed errors in save data for several old players.[/p]

notes.title: Time travel to the Three Kingdoms is today
notes.content: [p]The first interactive movie - game themed around the Three Kingdoms, "Restart ShuHan Dynasty: Origin", is launched today at an all - time low price. Welcome all generals to come and experience it.[/p]

notes.title: Scheduled to be launched on September 14th!
notes.content: [p]Such a large - scale game! Such a theme! Such an interactive movie game! Have you ever seen anything like it?[/p][p]Have you ever dreamed of going back to the eventful late Eastern Han Dynasty overnight?[/p][p]A modern soul strays into the chaotic world of the Three Kingdoms and actually becomes Liu Bei, who weaves mats and sells shoes - this time, history is written by you.[/p][p]It will be officially launched on the Steam platform on September 14th, 2025, taking you through the chaotic Three Kingdoms era![/p]
